definitions.gloss: bedwetting; wetting the bed; nocturnal enuresis
definitions.explanation: Involuntary urination during sleep, typically referring to children who have not yet outgrown the habit. Used in everyday conversation about child development as well as in medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Bedwetting often resolves naturally as the child grows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If bedwetting continues even after starting elementary school, you should consult a pediatrician.

notes:
Composed of {寝|ね} (sleeping) and ⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧ (urine, urination). A colloquial term used in everyday conversation, particularly among parents discussing child development. The verb form is {寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wet the bed
- {寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧: for bedwetting to stop
- {寝小便|ねしょうべん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧: bedwetting habit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おねしょ→おねしょ：09094_onesho⟧: bedwetting — the more common, child-friendly word used in casual conversation with children
- ⟦{夜尿症|やにょうしょう}→夜尿症：27749_yanyoushou⟧: nocturnal enuresis — the formal medical term used by doctors and in clinical settings

USAGE:
In casual speech with children, ⟦おねしょ→おねしょ：09094_onesho⟧ is far more common. {寝小便|ねしょうべん} is used more among adults or in somewhat more direct, matter-of-fact contexts.
